title: Calibrating One-Round Membership Inference with Neighbors
abstract: arXiv:2609.36331v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The state-of-the-art Membership Inference (MI) methods calibrate their signal separately for each example using reference models, auxiliary models trained to exclude the target. This paradigm scales poorly to modern large models, however, whose training is too expensive to replicate. This has motivated one-round settings, where only a single trained model is available; but without reference models the per-example calibration that drives the strongest attacks can no longer be estimated, leaving the membership signal weak. We ask whether neighbors of the target point can recover this calibration without training any additional model. Our key observation is that reference models serve only to reveal how an example behaves under models not trained on it, and that querying the target model on nearby samples yields the same information. translated_title: 利用邻近样本校准单轮成员推断
translated_abstract: 当前最先进的成员推断（MI）方法使用参考模型（即训练时排除目标样本的辅助模型）为每个样本单独校准信号。然而，这种范式难以扩展到现代大型模型，因为其训练成本过于昂贵而无法复制。这促使了“单轮设置”的出现，即只有一个已训练好的模型可用；但在没有参考模型的情况下，驱动最强攻击的逐样本校准便无法再被估计，导致成员信号较弱。我们探究目标点的邻近样本能否在不训练任何额外模型的情况下恢复这种校准。我们的关键观察是：参考模型的作用仅仅是揭示一个样本在未见过它的模型上的行为表现，而在目标模型上查询邻近样本可以获得相同的信息。我们提出了两种互补的方法来获取这样的邻近样本，并表明在早期训练检查点上查询它们……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出无需训练任何额外模型，仅通过在目标模型上查询目标样本的邻近点即可恢复成员推断所需的逐样本校准，从而在只有单个训练模型的单轮设置下实现强大的成员推断攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that per-example calibration for membership inference can be recovered without training any additional models, by querying the target model on neighboring samples of the target point, enabling strong attacks in one-round settings where only a single trained model is available.
